config.witness_selection: first nontrivial state by existing dataset/block/source/state metadata order, then its minimum span_two_lower witness across all five previously sampled pools; one per dataset
config.source_states: all60 states; all17 alias-only states retained as exclusions; all43 nontrivial mean contexts and114 exact first-action branches
config.coefficient_scope: exact GP posterior mean conditional on the computed binary kernel matrix; inverse-residual coefficient enclosures; no transcendental-kernel, stored-oracle-output or PDE error certification
config.pruning: outward-relaxed affine pair inequalities plus exact rational proof for every excluded candidate; ambiguous candidates retained
config.strong_comparator: same-state entire eligible1024-point pool using identical point-bound values and within-state exact cache sharing
config.independent_study_gate: candidate reduction alone is insufficient; require validated downstream category or selection information, complete-cost benefit against the strong comparator, and a reachable-history extension for the original H5 target before freezing new independent labels
